items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I used to go around and listen to Buddy Pete Teeth and those guys in the Papa Salstein band.

ctx.x: And they were wonderful guys. Can you tell us how you happened to take up drums and when you took up drums? About how old you were? I'd taken up drums when I was about 20 years old.
I used to go around and listen to Buddy Pete Teeth and those guys in the Papa Salstein band. And I always loved to play the drum. I would get on tin cans and tubs, you know, and beat like that.
You started out beating on things.
